model.title: John A. Hauser Mental Health in Aviation Act
model.meta: Commerce, Science, and Transportation Committee · Sen. John Hoeven (R-ND)

summary.text: The bill would require the Federal Aviation Administration to revise its regulations to make it easier for pilots and other aviation workers who have disclosed a mental health diagnosis or condition to obtain or maintain their certifications, aiming to reduce barriers for individuals seeking mental health treatment without fear of losing their aviation careers.
